title: Crispy Oven Roasted Chicken Drumsticks
description: A classic American appetizer or snack, these crispy roasted chicken drumsticks are perfect for game day or a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the chicken drumsticks and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl and toss them to coat with the spice mixture.
Line a baking sheet with foil or parchment paper and spray with cooking spray.
Arrange the chicken drumsticks on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is crispy.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
